evals.prompt: Release a new patch version of AIUsage with version bump and GitHub release.
evals.expected_output: Inspect current version and run ./scripts/release.sh --patch, which tests, bumps AppVersion.swift and scripts/build_app.sh, commits, tags vX.Y.Z, and pushes; GitHub Actions (release.yml) then builds the DMGs and publishes the release. Point the user to the workflow run.

evals.prompt: Bump AIUsage to v2.2.0, generate universal DMG installers, and push a release to GitHub.
evals.expected_output: Run ./scripts/release.sh 2.2.0 (or --minor), pushing the bump commit and tag to origin main; the Release workflow builds the signed DMGs and publishes the GitHub release with a changelog generated from Conventional Commits.

evals.prompt: Do a dry run release check for AIUsage to see what files will change and what release artifacts will be produced.
evals.expected_output: Run ./scripts/release.sh --dry-run --patch to preview the test run, version bump, commit, tag, and push without modifying files or git state, and explain that publishing happens in GitHub Actions.
